description: One advanced search: status, leads so far, progress by keyword, its top places and the newest batch running now.

campaign_id.description: An id from run_advanced_search or list_advanced_searches.

name: get_advanced_search

by_keyword.description: Each { keyword, exact, category, searches, searches_done, leads }.

estimate.description: { expected_leads, low, high, minutes } as estimated when it started.

finish_reason.description: all_searched | lead_limit | stopped once finished; null while it runs.

leads_with.description: How to read its leads: query_leads or export_leads with campaign_id.

resume_at.description: When a waiting search carries on by itself.

running_now.description: The newest batch running now: { keyword, places, status, verified, of }.

status.description: running | paused | completed | stopped. Paused by itself when a Free account runs out of leads (they don't renew: upgrade, then resume).

status_detail.description: One sentence on where it is — e.g. waiting for the daily city budget, and until when, or why it was paused.

top_places.description: Each { place, leads, basis }: basis "leads" — leads delivered there; or basis "businesses_checked" — leads null and businesses_checked the businesses checked there, when leads per place are not known.

title: Get an advanced search
